caption: Positano, Amalfi Coast
composition: Floodlit cliffside town cascading to the sea at night · AI-generated artistic interpretation
description: From an elevated viewpoint off the coast, the camera looks along Positano as the lit town cascades down the cliffs toward the dark sea in the 05:04 pre-dawn night. Houses in white, pink, and ochre stack across the center and left slopes, while the church's pale dome glows at the lower right above the waterfront and the beach curves into shadow along the bottom edge. Warm window lights trace the hillside roads, and a few boat lights dot the black water.
alt_text: AI-generated artistic interpretation of Positano on the Amalfi Coast lit at night cascading to the beach
